gps.title: GPS Location
gps.desc: Required to calculate transits from your position

notifications.title: Push Notifications
notifications.desc: To alert you when a transit is approaching

install.title: Install App
install.desc: Add to home screen for the best experience

radar.title: The Radar
radar.desc: You are at the center. Moon and Sun are fixed points in the sky. Aircraft move — green means on a transit path.

radius.title: Search radius
radius.desc: How many km around you we query for aircraft. 25 km is the optimal value to avoid noise.

margin.title: Angular margin
margin.desc: The tolerance to call an aircraft 'in transit'. Moon and Sun are ~0.5° in diameter. At ±0.5° you only catch true disk transits.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.desc: Install the app and enable notifications to receive alerts even with your phone in your pocket.
